answer: At t+0, a newcomer stakes 1,000 cedar coins. They must prove ownership of a unique crystal keypair by hashing it into a karst cave, forming a beacon chain. At epoch close, cedar coin holders verify the chain. If a chain is broken, each coin holder loses 10 cedar coins. Mass cloning fails when attackers spend 10,000 cedar coins but only earn 9,990 cedar coins back, leaving them with a net loss of 10 cedar coins.
